newsitem.title: USA: Media General to sell, buy newspapers.
newsitem.headline: Media General to sell, buy newspapers.

text.p: Newspaper publisher Media General said Tuesday it planned a series of newspaper sales, valued at about $139 million, and purchases valued at about $52 million.
The company said that the sales will allow it to leave the Northeastern and Midwestern markets and strengthen its presence in Virginia and North Carolina, as well as in its core Southeastern market.

Media General said it will sell 43 papers for about $107 million to Community Newspaper Holdings Inc., of Lexington, Ky. The papers are located in Clinton and Lumberton, N.C.; Sapulpa and McAlester, Okla.; Devil's Lake, N.D.; Burley, Idaho; Jefferson and Plymouth, Ind.; Effingham and Macomb, Ill.; Lockport and Medina, N.Y.; and Warner Robins, Ga.
Other scheduled sales include five papers in and around Bemidji, Minn., to Forum Communications, Inc., for about $10.65 million.

Media General also plans to sell 10 papers in and around Hudson and Ogdensburg, N.Y., to the Johnson Newspaper Corp. for about $8.85 million; two papers in Rockingham County, N.C., to Community Newspapers Inc., for about $8.1 million; and two papers in and around Coldwater, Mich., to Wicks Group of Companies Inc., for about $4 million.

Media General said it will acquire the Potomac News in Woodbridge, Va., valued at about $48 million, in an exchange with Community Newspaper Holdings Inc., following that company's acquisition of the paper from Garden State Newspapers Inc.

Media General also said it planned to buy, for about $4.1 million, the Reidsville (N.C.) Review, a five day evening paper; the Madison (N.C.) Messenger, a twice weekly, and Entertainment in Review, a weekly, from Rockingham Newspapers Inc. of Houston.

When the transactions are completed, Media General will operate a total of 20 daily newspapers in the Southeast, including the 10 dailies it currently owns in the region, along with a number of weekly and periodical publications.
Media General stock was down 75 cents at $29.75 in afternoon trading on the American Stock Exchange.
